sourceName: Natural Earth country geometry with spherical surname envelopes

candidatePolicy.centerRanking: all interior grid centers ranked by a 7-step dense long-envelope fit; best center hill-climbed for 4 halving rounds
candidatePolicy.centredCandidates: per wordmark shape (square, medium, long): the horizontal center maximizing fit * (1 - 0.4 * min(1, anchor distance / countryScaleCap)), hill-climbed the same way
candidatePolicy.narrowRotationRule: offered when interior-point principal-axis elongation >= 2, within 35deg of that axis; kept when >= 1.15 * the best horizontal fit
candidatePolicy.isolatedOverflowFormula: eligible when foreign clearance >= max(2.5 * strict fit, strict fit + max(0.75deg, 0.9 * equivalent radius)); cap=min(strict fit + 0.8 * equivalent radius, 0.75 * foreign clearance, 2.8 * equivalent radius, 20deg)
